# 6、输入下面内容

- 连接方式：图片 → `ref_images.ref_image_0`，mp3 → `drive_audio`
- 提示词要点：不写 `<Audio 1>` 标签；在 `subject_definitions` / `summary` / `detailed_description` 三处显式声明 "口型与驱动音频逐音节同步"，每个 Shot 说话时再补充具体的嘴部开合、下颌运动细节。

subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the on-camera presenter, a young East Asian woman whose appearance is locked to the reference portrait image wired to ref_images.ref_image_0: fair smooth skin, soft natural makeup, warm nude-orange lips, brown eyes, and straight black hair tied in a low ponytail with a few loose face-framing strands; she wears a champagne-ivory satin slip midi dress with thin spaghetti straps and a sweetheart cowl neckline, and a silver textured heart-pendant necklace. Her Mandarin dialogue is supplied by the driving audio (drive_audio), and her on-screen lip movements must follow the rule "口型与驱动音频逐音节同步" — every mouth opening and closing, and every jaw movement, is locked syllable by syllable to the driving audio. <Subject 2> is the product, a pair of glossy patent-leather peep-toe d'Orsay high-heel sandals whose appearance is locked to the shoe reference image wired to ref_images.ref_image_1: a royal-cobalt-blue patent toe box and insole, a bright fuchsia-pink quarter and heel counter, metallic gold crisscross straps across the vamp, a gold circular ornament set with one large clear rhinestone at the center of the toe, pink trim along the peep-toe edge, d'Orsay cutaway sides, a sculptural curved flared royal-blue heel with a black heel tip and a thin gold accent line, and a black outsole edge. <Subject 3> is the warm cozy home-studio setting: dark wood-paneled walls, a backlit glass display cabinet with warm LED strips and decorative objects, a green leafy plant on the left, a floral arrangement on the right, and a light oak wood floor. <Video 1> is the source reference video that supplies the full 15-second timeline, the four-shot structure, the fixed camera setups, the presenter's hand and body actions, the hard cuts, and the timing of the call-to-action graphic.
summary: [reference generation] The target is a 15-second vertical short-video e-commerce pitch for <Subject 2>, the color-block peep-toe d'Orsay high heels. <Subject 1> presents and demonstrates the product inside <Subject 3>, strictly following the shot order, camera setups, actions, hard cuts, and call-to-action graphic timing of <Video 1>, while the presenter's face, low ponytail, makeup, satin slip dress, and heart necklace remain locked to the portrait image (ref_images.ref_image_0), and the shoes' blue-pink-gold color blocking, gold rhinestone ornament, and sculptural heel remain locked to the shoe reference image (ref_images.ref_image_1). Her Mandarin dialogue is supplied by the driving audio (drive_audio), and her lip movements follow the rule "口型与驱动音频逐音节同步", with on-screen mouth and jaw motion tracking every syllable of that driving audio.
retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the young woman's face, low ponytail, natural makeup, champagne satin slip dress, and silver heart-pendant necklace are locked to the reference portrait image; her speaking and demonstration actions follow <Video 1>. <Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the peep-toe d'Orsay sandals are locked to the shoe reference image, retaining the cobalt-blue patent toe and insole, fuchsia-pink heel counter, gold crisscross straps, central rhinestone gold ornament, and sculptural curved blue heel. <Subject 3> (appears in all shots): fully_preserved - the warm wood-paneled home studio, backlit display cabinet, green plant, flowers, and oak floor are retained. <Video 1> (timeline, camera, composition, actions, cuts, CTA timing): partially_preserved - the 15-second four-shot timeline, fixed camera positions, hand gestures, hard cuts, and the 限时秒杀 shopping-cart overlay timing are preserved; the presenter's appearance and the product's appearance are replaced by the two locked reference images.
detailed_description: The target is a polished warm-toned vertical (9:16) short-video e-commerce pitch, with soft warm indoor key light, shallow depth of field in the product close-up, and bright enthusiastic livestream energy. Throughout the whole video, every time <Subject 1> speaks on camera her lip movements follow the rule "口型与驱动音频逐音节同步", tracking the driving audio syllable by syllable. [Shot 1] A fixed eye-level medium close-up opens on <Subject 1>, the young East Asian woman in the champagne-ivory satin slip dress and silver heart-pendant necklace, her black hair in a low ponytail, standing front-on to the lens inside <Subject 3>. She holds up the pair of <Subject 2> peep-toe d'Orsay sandals by the heels in both hands, presenting them toward the camera with both shoes fanned open so the cobalt patent toe, fuchsia heel counter, gold crisscross straps, and the central rhinestone ornament catch the light. She addresses the lens directly as <Subject 1> (S1), her mouth opening wide and her jaw dropping on the opener, lips spreading into a bright smile, and the mouth opening and closing in tight even beats that land on every syllable of the driving audio, with a small chin lift on 蓝玫鎏光 and on the emphasized 绝了, saying <d>[Chinese] 姐妹们看过来！这双蓝玫鎏光高跟鞋，质感真的绝了。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, a hard cut drops to an extreme macro close-up of a single <Subject 2> sandal. The camera slowly tilts and drifts over the glossy cobalt patent toe and the gold crisscross straps, revealing the fine patent-leather grain, the stitched seams, and the central gold ornament set with its faceted clear rhinestone that sparkles as the light moves, against a warm blurred bokeh background. Two manicured hands with nude-pink nails enter: one pinches the d'Orsay side opening from the top, the fingertip of the other strokes and presses the padded blue insole to show its soft give. The same voice of <Subject 1> (S1) continues as off-screen narration following the driving audio (her face is off-screen, so no on-camera lip movement appears in this shot), saying <d>[Chinese] 大家看这漆皮，撞色亮眼，镂空金属扣非常精致；鞋垫软软的，久穿不累脚。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, a hard cut drops to a near-floor low-angle shot of <Subject 1>'s bare lower legs wearing <Subject 2>, standing on the light oak floor of <Subject 3>. She shifts her weight and takes a slow step so the peep-toe, the cobalt-blue upper, and the sculptural curved flared heel clearly lengthen the leg line; the camera stays low as she crouches and her fingertip presses gently at the pink shoe collar near the ankle to show the soft, non-rubbing fit, then she settles the foot back flat. The voice of <Subject 1> (S1) continues as off-screen narration following the driving audio (her face remains out of frame in this low-angle shot), saying <d>[Chinese] 上脚超显腿长！而且你们看，异形跟很稳当，走路一点都不磨脚。</d> [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, a hard cut returns to the fixed eye-level medium close-up of <Subject 1> facing the lens in <Subject 3>. She breaks into an eager smile, raises one hand, and points her index finger upward and then toward the lower-left of the frame. A call-to-action overlay appears in the lower-left: bold red Chinese characters with a white outline reading 限时秒杀, sitting above a glowing orange circular shopping-cart icon. Speaking directly to the lens, <Subject 1> (S1) opens her mouth wide on 限时秒杀, lets her jaw drop on 手慢无哦, and presses her lips together on the final 姐妹们, every mouth opening and jaw movement synced to the syllables of the driving audio, saying <d>[Chinese] 现在下单限时秒杀，左下角购物车，手慢无哦，姐妹们！</d>
overall_soundscape: A quiet warm indoor home-studio room tone runs throughout the 15 seconds. Light physical accents accompany the action: the faint soft rustle of glossy patent leather as the hands handle and press the sandal, the tiny metallic glint of the rhinestone ornament, and a few gentle taps of the sculptural curved heel on the oak floor during the step and crouch.
non_diegetic_music: N/A — the driving audio (drive_audio) carries the presenter's Mandarin dialogue; no separate audience-only background score is added.

视频中文案内容：

（0–3s）：姐妹们看过来！这双蓝玫鎏光高跟鞋，质感真的绝了。
（3–8s）：大家看这漆皮，撞色亮眼，镂空金属扣非常精致；鞋垫软软的，久穿不累脚。
（8–12s）：上脚超显腿长！而且你们看，异形跟很稳当，走路一点都不磨脚。
（12–15s）：现在下单限时秒杀，左下角购物车，手慢无哦，姐妹们！
